---
name: Enhancement
about: Suggest an improvement or new feature
title: "[ENHANCEMENT] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A clear, one or two sentence description of what you'd like added or changed.

## Motivation

Why is this needed? What problem does it solve, or what workflow does it improve?

## Proposed Approach

How you imagine this working. Doesn't need to be final, just a starting point for discussion.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't go with them (optional).
